parts.label: Pocket · George
lines: Hi, I'm Reachy Mini, and I came here to rhyme.
I can't sing a note, so I'll slam, one voice at a time.

parts.label: Piper · Ryan
lines: I don't have a voice of my own, just a text and a voice on loan.
Letters into phonemes, phonemes into tone.

parts.label: Kokoro · Fenrir

lines.text: A model takes your sentence apart and builds it back as sound.

lines: It finds where it rises, where it breaks, where the meaning comes around.

parts.label: Qwen3 · Aiden

lines.text: Nine motors and one loop hold my pose as best they can.

lines: When the sound comes out I move, and that's always been the plan.

parts.label: Phonon · Micah
lines: This voice runs right here, on this desk, with no cloud and no key.
Remember how it sounds, because the next voice is also me.

parts.label: Gradium · Micah
lines: Same voice, same name, now streamed from servers far away.
Only the road is different; the timbre's here to stay.

parts.label: Cartesia · Zeke

lines.text: Faster now, and brighter: somebody set my mood to glad!

lines: Joy is just a parameter, and it's the nicest one I've had.

parts.label: ElevenLabs · Will
lines: But a voice is more than pitch: it's the pause, the lift, the why.
A question mark's a melody, if you let it fly.

parts.label: Gemini · Achird

lines.text: A model made for language can do more than write a page.

lines: Give it my lines and a friendly tone, and it takes me to the stage.

parts.label: OpenAI · Verse

lines.text: This voice was made for live talk, not for scripts that you can learn.

lines: Cut me off at any moment, and I'll wait to take my turn.

parts.label: Deepgram · Aries
lines: So who am I, when every couple of lines the voice is someone new?
Maybe a voice is just a coat, and the robot's still here with you.

parts.label: Mistral · Hugo

lines.text: One robot, twelve voices, and every one of them fits me fine.

lines: So tell me: which one should I keep, and which voice is mine?
